```{r}
# =========================
# Libraries
# =========================
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

# =========================
# LOAD DATA
# =========================
df <- read.csv("mouse_prepost_raw.csv")

data <- df

# =========================
# FUNCTION
# =========================
plot_mouse_prepost <- function(df,
                                pre_col,
                                post_col,
                                value_name = "signal",
                                condition_filter = NULL,
                                genotype_filter = NULL) {

  # --------------------------
  # FILTERING
  # --------------------------
  if (!is.null(condition_filter)) {
    data <- data %>% filter(condition == condition_filter)
  }

  if (!is.null(genotype_filter)) {
    data <- data %>% filter(genotype == genotype_filter)
  }

  data <- data %>% filter(behavior != "Other")

  if (nrow(data) == 0) {
    print("[WARN] No data to plot")
    return(NULL)
  }

  # --------------------------
  # ORDERING
  # --------------------------
  week_order <- c("Preinduction", "W1", "W2", "W3")
  data$week <- factor(data$week, levels = week_order, ordered = TRUE)

  behaviors <- unique(data$behavior)

  # ==========================
  # LOOP BEHAVIORS
  # ==========================
  for (beh in behaviors) {

    sub <- data %>% filter(behavior == beh)

    # ==========================
    # STATS (PAIRED t-test)
    # ==========================
    stats_results <- list()

    for (gen in unique(sub$genotype)) {

      sub_gen <- sub %>% filter(genotype == gen)

      for (w in week_order) {

        sub_w <- sub_gen %>% filter(week == w)

        # reshape to paired format per mouse
        wide <- sub_w %>%
          select(mouse_id, all_of(pre_col), all_of(post_col)) %>%
          drop_na()

        if (nrow(wide) < 2) next

        # paired t-test
        test <- t.test(
          wide[[pre_col]],
          wide[[post_col]],
          paired = TRUE
        )

        # paired Cohen's d
        diff <- wide[[post_col]] - wide[[pre_col]]
        cohens_d <- mean(diff) / sd(diff)

        stats_results[[length(stats_results) + 1]] <- data.frame(
          genotype = gen,
          week = w,
          t_stat = test$statistic,
          p_value = test$p.value,
          cohens_d = cohens_d
        )
      }
    }

    stats_df <- bind_rows(stats_results)

    # Bonferroni correction
    if (nrow(stats_df) > 0) {
      stats_df$p_corrected <- p.adjust(stats_df$p_value, method = "bonferroni")
    }

    print(paste("Stats for", beh))
    print(stats_df)

    # ==========================
    # LONG FORMAT
    # ==========================
    long_sub <- sub %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols = c(all_of(pre_col), all_of(post_col)),
        names_to = "window",
        values_to = value_name
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        window = recode(window,
                        !!pre_col := "Pre",
                        !!post_col := "Post")
      )

    # ==========================
    # PLOT
    # ==========================
    p <- ggplot(long_sub, aes(x = week, y = .data[[value_name]], fill = window)) +

      stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "bar",
                   position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.6) +

      stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar",
                   position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.2) +

      geom_jitter(aes(color = window),
                  position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.1,
                                                  dodge.width = 0.8),
                  size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +

      facet_wrap(~genotype) +

      ggtitle(paste("Behavior:", beh)) +

      theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
      theme(legend.position = "none")

    # ==========================
    # SIGNIFICANCE ANNOTATION
    # ==========================
    if (nrow(stats_df) > 0) {

      y_max <- max(long_sub[[value_name]], na.rm = TRUE)

      for (i in seq_len(nrow(stats_df))) {

        row <- stats_df[i, ]

        label <- ""

        if (!is.na(row$p_corrected)) {
          if (row$p_corrected < 0.001) label <- "***"
          else if (row$p_corrected < 0.01) label <- "**"
          else if (row$p_corrected < 0.05) label <- "*"
        }

        if (label != "") {

          week_idx <- match(row$week, week_order)

          p_plot <- p + annotate(
            "text",
            x = week_idx,
            y = y_max * 1.1,
            label = label,
            size = 5
          )

          p <- p_plot
        }
      }
    }

    print(p)
  }
}
plot_mouse_prepost(
  df,
  pre_col = "pre_mean_dFF",
  post_col = "post_mean_dFF",
  value_name = "Mean dF/F",
  condition_filter = "Social",
  genotype_filter = "NE"
)
```

df_filtered <- df %>%
  filter(week == "W1", behavior == "Social_interaction", condition == "Social", genotype == "NE")
t.test(df_filtered$pre_mean_dFF, df_filtered$post_mean_dFF, paired = TRUE)

```{r}
df_filtered_lmer <- df %>%
  filter(behavior == "Novel_interaction",
         condition == "Novel",
         genotype == "NE")

df_filtered_lmer$delta <- df_filtered_lmer$post_mean_dFF - df_filtered_lmer$pre_mean_dFF

m_anova <- lmerTest::lmer(delta ~ week + (1 | mouse_id), data = df_filtered_lmer)
summary(m_anova)

library(emmeans)
library(ggplot2)

# -------------------------
# Estimated means per week
# -------------------------
emm <- emmeans(m_anova, ~ week)
emm_df <- as.data.frame(emm)

# -------------------------
# Dunnett contrasts (vs control)
# -------------------------
dunnett_results <- contrast(
  emm,
  method = "trt.vs.ctrl",
  ref = 1
)

dunnett_df <- as.data.frame(dunnett_results)

# -------------------------
# KEEP ONLY SIGNIFICANT RESULTS
# -------------------------
dunnett_df <- dunnett_df[dunnett_df$p.value < 0.05, ]

# y position for labels
y_pos <- max(df_filtered_lmer$delta, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1

# -------------------------
# PLOT
# -------------------------
ggplot() +
  
  # RAW DATA
  geom_jitter(
    data = df_filtered_lmer,
    aes(x = week, y = delta),
    width = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.5,
    size = 2
  ) +
  
  # MODEL MEAN
  geom_point(
    data = emm_df,
    aes(x = week, y = emmean),
    size = 3,
    color = "red"
  ) +
  
  # MODEL SE
  geom_errorbar(
    data = emm_df,
    aes(x = week,
        ymin = emmean - SE,
        ymax = emmean + SE),
    width = 0.15,
    color = "red"
  ) +
  
  # MODEL TREND
  geom_line(
    data = emm_df,
    aes(x = week, y = emmean, group = 1),
    color = "red"
  ) +
  
  # # SIGNIFICANT ONLY P VALUES
  # geom_text(
  #   data = dunnett_df,
  #   aes(
  #     x = 2,
  #     y = y_pos,
  #     label = paste0("p = ", signif(p.value, 2))
  #   ),
  #   inherit.aes = FALSE,
  #   size = 3
  # ) +
  
  theme_classic() +
  ylab("Δ dF/F (post - pre)") +
  xlab("Week")
```
